Interface DbOps

All Known Implementing Classes:
DbOpsBase
public interface DbOps
Interface that provides a set of methods to perform custom operations before and/or after certain database related operations. SS requires that application changes to the database are reflected in the RowSet; thus the displayed information has the changes that are made. Typically the "Pre" operations operate on SsComponents associated with an app window; and the "Post" operations make sure the changes are visible in the RowSet (commonly by re-executing the query). There are also other methods to prevent/allow or assist certain actions, for example allowDelete() or performCancelOps().

In this class' documentation there are references to RowsAction enum values which have associated actions. The actions are typically invoked by a navigator button push which invokes the associated action, for example see SsDataNavigator

This interface has only default methods, none of which do anything; it can be instantiated by doing new DbOps() {}.

Generally the user will want to use/extend DbOpsBase

  • it has an implementation of performPreInsertOps() that will clear/initialize SsComponent values before editing.
  • it has implementations of performPostInsertOps(rowsModel) and other performPost*Ops that use metadata to decide if the RowSet command needs to be re-executed.
  • it handles state info for allow update/insert/delete.

  • Method Details

    • allowInsert

      default boolean allowInsert()
      This function is called as the first step, before inserting the row into the database, of RowsAction.ACT_COMMIT.
      Returns:
      true if row can be inserted, false aborts the operation

    • allowDelete

      default boolean allowDelete()
      This function is called as the first step, before performPreDeletionOps is called, of RowsAction.ACT_DELETE.
      Returns:
      true if the row can be deleted else false and the action is aborted

    • allowUpdate

      default boolean allowUpdate()
      This functions is called just before doing something that is sensitive to a row being dirty. When it returns true, it is followed by rowSet.updateRow(). Note that the default for AutoCommit is false. So the behavior of SsDataNavigator in conjunction with RowsAction is that when the current row is dirty only commit and undo are enabled.
      Returns:
      true is the row can be updated else false.

    • performCancelOps

      default void performCancelOps()
      This method is invoked by RowsAction.ACT_REVERT, the undo button, to perform operations after either rowSet.cancelRowUpdates or rowSet.moveToCurrentRow. Only meaningful if either the current row is modified, or a row is being inserted.

    • performRefreshOps

      default void performRefreshOps()
      Method to perform operations when the user hits the refresh button. This method is invoked at the end of RowsAction.ACT_REFRESH; note the rowSet's query is re-executed and the cursor is positioned at the first row.

    • performNavigationOps

      default void performNavigationOps(RowsAction.Navigation navigationType)
      Method to perform navigation-related operations, in particular at the end of RowsAction.ACT_FIRST, RowsAction.ACT_LAST, RowsAction.ACT_NEXT, and RowsAction.ACT_PREVIOUS.
      Parameters:
      navigationType - type of navigation that was done

    • performPreInsertOps

      default void performPreInsertOps()
      Method to perform pre-insertion operations by RowsAction.ACT_ADD after rowSet.moveToInsertRow. Typically initializes all the columns' SsComponents. See DbOpsBase.performPreInsertOps().

    • performPostInsertOps

      default void performPostInsertOps(RowsModel rm) throws SQLException
      Method to perform post-insertion operations during RowsAction.ACT_COMMIT after rowSet.insertRow. If the insert is aborted, RowsAction.ACT_REVERT cancelling a pending insert, this is not called.

      In addition to this, a listener on the RowSet is notified after the RowSet is modified.

      Parameters:
      rm -
      Throws:
      SQLException

    • performPreDeletionOps

      default void performPreDeletionOps()
      Method to perform pre-deletion operations; it is used for RowsAction.ACT_DELETE, invoked just before rowSet.deleteRow().

    • performPostDeletionOps

      default void performPostDeletionOps(RowsModel rm) throws SQLException
      Method to perform post-deletion operations; it is used for RowsAction.ACT_DELETE, invoked just after rowSet.deleteRow().

      In addition to this, a listener on the RowSet is notified after the RowSet is modified.

      Parameters:

    • performPostUpdateOps

      default void performPostUpdateOps(RowsModel rm) throws SQLException
      Method to perform operations at the end of RowsAction.ACT_COMMIT when the current row is modified, i.e. not on the insert row. It is invoked after rowSet.updateRow().
